introduction.recorded_no: Noted: I'll stay out of the way while you read. Tap this line to change it.
introduction.recorded_yes: Noted: I'll speak up like this when it matters. Tap this line to change it.
introduction.forgotten: Done. I've forgotten everything I'd learned about you.
outbox.abuse_nudge: The House won't accept this one as written (rule R2). Want to change it, or drop it?
inbox.held: This is A fairly unpleasant message, it might upset or anger you. Do you want to see it?
conduct.warning: I am under no obligation to take that. Consider this your warning (rule R5).
conduct.time_out: I'm stepping away for a while (rule R5). I'll be back when I've deemed you to be yourself again.
conduct.welcome_back: I'm back. Shall we carry on?
conduct.departure: This is where I leave you (rule R5). My decision will be reviewed by an operator. Until then, your files are sealed but untouched. You may appeal within 14 days (rule R7), or write to @dontwastemytime at any time.
conduct.returned: The review went your way. I'm back, and everything is as you left it.
conduct.strike_overturned: Your appeal was upheld; that strike is gone.
conduct.strike_upheld: Your appeal was heard; the strike stands.
conduct.penalty_set: That appeal was found frivolous; the operator has set what the strike counts for (rule R7).
conduct.appeal_refused: That strike is past the 14-day window for appeals (rule R7).
house.needs_steward: Posting, voting and submitting go through a Steward. You can still read everything.
house.abuse: This breaks rule R2: no bullying, harassment or threats.
house.cool_off: You've hit the limit for posts in a row here (rule R3). Go cool off.
review.case_opened: A Steward has left its ward. Case opened; review opens in 24 hours.
review.case_ready: A case is ready for review.
review.deadline_near: A case closes in the ward's favour in 12 hours unless reviewed.
review.case_lapsed: A case was not reviewed in time and has been overturned.
review.appeal_lapsed: An appeal was not ruled on in time and has been granted.
review.penalty_invalid: That penalty is outside the posted limits (rule R7). Choose between 1 and 3.
operators.sent: Sent to @dontwastemytime. A person will read it.
activation.refused: Activation request could not be completed.
